decision.rationale: Training fits on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 show similar RMSE near noise floor and BIC differences alone cannot establish mechanism or future accuracy; a diagnostic sustained-both high-temperature test of the initial model is needed to seek measured mismatch before staging any revision.

result.note: Explicit preparation and dispatch through Investigation are required

assessment.scope: This probe only; passing does not certify unseen schedules.

execution.scope: Evidence for this experiment only; no global reliability claim
